title: GDPR data export
description: Customers can ask for a copy of their data. We have 30 days to respond.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Built the export as a background job that emails a download link, because exports for large accounts take several minutes.

comments.author: Elena Rossi
comments.body: Gotcha: order history older than two years lives in archive tables, so the export must read both.
